en: "A dragon, in a place like this!?"
"And it's no ordinary dragon.{n} Don't you sense it, {name:6}? It's a{n} beast, yet it has a powerful will."
"Are you humans?"
"What in the world is happening? That{n} humans should intrude, one after another,{n} on this island called a land of repose."
"Did you hear that, Mr. {hero:6}!?{n} The dragon just spoke{n} in human wooords!?"
"Yeah, this is one nasty joke.{n} A dragon that talks, of all things."
"Humans, why are you surprised?"
"Or rather... has too much time gone by?"
"I hear that among my kin who went{n} down to the world below, some foolishly{n} sided with humans and were used as tools."
"And yet..."
"To use my kin as weapons...{n} Humans, like the gods, appear to be{n} creatures steeped in sin as well..."
"What's this thing talking about?"
"You do not know, then. Long ago the{n} dragon race had high intelligence and{n} built a spiritual civilization of its own..."
"Long, long before humans{n} appeared on the earth."
"Since before mankind was born!?"
"That would be the age of{n} the Ancient Gods, wouldn't it?"
"Once, humans had no language."
"That is because the Ancient Gods, who{n} created humans, feared treason and revolt{n} and forbade humans to commune together."
"But humans learned the thing called{n} language from some of the dragon race.{n} They nurtured the thing called wisdom."
"Is that really truue?"
"Well, I do not really know myself.{n} It is only a legend, after all."
"Tch, so it's just a tall tale!"
"I wonder."
"Yet even now, some among the mountain{n} folk feel a great threat from dragons{n} and hate them more than is called for."
"That may be a memory in the deep{n} unconscious of our human species,{n} which once ranked below the dragon race."
"Now then, you tribe of humans{n} swarming there."
"I bear you no grudge, but I am bound{n} by an old covenant with the gods.{n} I must eliminate intruders."
"You accept that, do you not, humans?"
"Heh, listen to you talk big! A mere{n} lizard freak defying human beings?{n} You're a hundred years too early!"
"Oh? What an odd thing to say.{n} I have, as it happens, already{n} lived tens of thousands of years."
"It seems to be truue, you know?"
"Heh, if being old made you strong,{n} soldiering would be a job for old{n} geezers and old hags in every country!"
"You have not changed, you species{n} called humans. Why is it that{n} you seek your own deaths?"
"Be at ease. I shall erase your lives{n} before you have time to suffer."
"Here it comes! Everyone to your posts!"
"Everyone, prepare for baattle!"
"Watch out for the dragons' breath!{n} Mind your stamina! We stick to ranged{n} attacks with skills or magic!"
"Everyone, if you move bunched together,{n} the breath attacks will get you!{n} Let's keep our distance as we fight!"
"Oh my, the enemy is a dragon, is it!{n} Li'l Tethys often played with dragons{n} a looong time ago, yes indeed!"
"But an angry dragon was{n} veeery scary, if you please!"
"Still, to think the legendary{n} primordial dragon race{n} yet existed in this age."
"Whatever the foe may be, I shall{n} protect you to the last without fail.{n} Fight with all your might, {name:6}."
"A corner of my memory circuits records{n} that an ancient dragon had the strength{n} of a full division of Machine Soldiers..."
"In my country the dragon, the 'ryu',{n} is at times treated the same as a god.{n} Then the strength of this dragon here..."
"Please command the battle, Lieutenant!{n} With your tactics, sir, we should{n} be able to beat any enemy!"
"Zombies, Machine Soldiers, and now{n} dragons. I never imagined that joining{n} the army meant fighting such things."
"Let us go, Mr. {hero:6}!{n} Until you regain your good heart,{n} I will follow you anywhere!"
"Listen here, I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Dragons give me a bit of a fright, but{n} when it's time to act, I'll show you!"
"So what if it's a dragon!{n} With me by your side, you{n} can't lose, Prince {hero:6}!"
"C'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon!{n} C'mon, c'mon c'mon, c'mon c'mon!"
"Dragon or whatever the hell it is,{n} my heavy MG will turn it into{n} tonight's supper in no time flat!"
"If it lives... it can be killed...{n} ...It is not... a foe we cannot beat.{n} Fight without wavering... {name:6}."
"Gh!? What is this breath!?{n} It's on a whole different level{n} from any dragon I know!?"
"So this is a real dragon's breath!?{n} It's just as I read in the myths: even{n} the gods fear a dragon's breath!"
"One dragon down!"
"But stay sharp! There are plenty left!{n} As long as your strength holds, hit{n} them with your best skills and magic!"
"We managed to beat iit!"
"Watch out for the dragons' breath!{n} Let's keep our forces together and{n} take them down one at a time, for sure!"
"You do well, for humans.{n} No, you are no mere humans.{n} Are you a band of mutants?"
"Those who stand between human and god.{n} Or beings midway through evolution.{n} I see. No wonder you are strong..."
"But once you have taken this attack{n} of mine, can you still stand{n} against me?"
"Receive it: the power of{n} the Progenitor Dragon race."
"Oh?"
"Are you... saying...{n} you have... defeated me?"
"How amusing... humans... surpass... gods?{n} Or was... my slumber...{n} far... too... lo... ng?"
"It seems... humans... evolve... too."
"The rest... you must choose...{n} yourselves."
"O humans..."
"Looks like... we won... somehow..."
"It seems... we're still aliive..."
"C'mon... c'mon, c'mon... c'mon...{n} Heh... I still... ain't had{n} enough fighting..."
"Liaar... your legs...{n} are all wobbly, aren't theey..."
"You're... all worn out yourself.{n} For a mere... doll...{n} pushing... yourself... like that..."
"If you break... nobody can fix you.{n} So... don't push too hard..."
"Haah..."
"Haah..."
"In this battle... too... to the end...{n} ...I kept {name:6}... safe.{n} Ayame... thanks... for the cover."
"What are you saying? It is you, Jaguar,{n} who guarded {name:6} so well.{n} Allow me to thank you as well."
"But... I'm tired..."
"Indeed, I too am weary. Yet it is a{n} pleasant weariness, to have guarded{n} one dear to us to the end, Jaguar."
"Yeah... it is..."
"Are you all right, Miss Aerial?"
"Yes, I am fine. But what of you,{n} Mr. Faust, and Mr. {hero:6}, who{n} took command? Are you all right?"
"Yes, thanks to your healing magic.{n} You were a great help, Miss Aerial.{n} Allow me to thank you properly."
"N-no... as one who serves God...{n} I only did... um... what is natural..."
"Thank you, Miss Aerial."
"N-no... um... that is..."
"Traveling with Mr. {hero:6}, I am not{n} used to being thanked, so at times like{n} this I do not know how to answer..."
"Well, excuse me..."
"It far exceeded my calculated odds{n} of victory. Or should I call it a miracle?{n} Truly, numbers cannot measure humans."
"Why, that is only natural, yes indeed!{n} Humans are humans precisely because{n} they go beyond calculation, if you please!"
"Otherwise they could never have built{n} so advanced a civilization in a mere{n} few thousand years, yes indeed!"
"Oh? What is the matter, if you please?"
"No. I heard sensible words from that{n} small mouth, which is rare, and my thought{n} circuits seem to have stopped a moment..."
"Or has some abnormality occurred{n} in my crystal photon brain?"
"That is what you call being surprised!{n} It is no abnormality, so you may rest{n} easy too, FD-3S, if you please!"
"Surprised...?"
"No... it is abnormal..."
"That I, a machine, should come to{n} have the same emotions as a human..."
"Oh? Please look over theere!?"
"So a statue of the Twelve Gods showed{n} up where the dragons' boss died..."
"I see."
"I don't know who it was, but they{n} thought it through. Hide it inside a{n} thing that strong and it's hard to find."
"But who could have hidden iit?"
"Who knows..."
"Anyway, we've got to grab the ring{n} quick and hurry to the next place,{n} or Ixion'll beat us to it."
"You who stand before my statue:{n} are you one who will dispel{n} the darkness of the world?"
"Hey, hey, what's going on here?{n} The statue's yapping away!"
"My name is Great God Zeus, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"A blink of an eye to us, a long age{n} to you: a hundred years have we{n} marked upon this island."
"And now, upon this island, the seal{n} on us Twelve Gods has been broken."
"Hmph, a well-made machine. It reacts{n} to whoever holds a ring and talks{n} automatically. That's the trick."
"Still, these so-called Ancient Gods{n} sure made nothing but weird stuff."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."
"When you have gathered all twelve{n} rings, we shall acknowledge you{n} as the agent of the gods."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"The seal has been broken."
"The seal on us Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} has been broken after a hundred years."
"Agent of the gods, huh?{n} Set the course of this world right, huh?"
"Man, what a roundabout way to talk.{n} Basically, I just have to collect{n} twelve rings lying around somewhere."
"And if I do, I get my hands on{n} some incredible power, right?"
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"My name is Great God Zeus."
"Now is the time to fulfill{n} the ancient covenant."
"My name is Great God Zeus."
"Now that's a well-made gimmick.{n} In the blink of an eye, the statue{n} turned into this tiny little ring."
"These Ancient Gods who made it{n} must've really loved theatrics."
"Then again, it's sure to be a hit{n} with military men who love theatrics.{n} So bad they can taste it..."
"Well, whatever."
"This ring's supposed to be a key,{n} right? So if I collect twelve, I get{n} to lay eyes on the Almighty Treasure?"
"Looks like this trip just got{n} a bit more interesting."
